#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a calendar event: Team Meeting, next Wednesday at 3 PM, 1 hour."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date, timezone

today = date.today()

# Compute next Wednesday (weekday() == 2 means Wednesday)
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # today is Wednesday -> use next week's Wednesday
next_wed = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

start_dt = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0, 0)
end_dt = start_dt + timedelta(hours=1)

print(f"Today: {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Event: {next_wed} ({next_wed.strftime('%A')}) 15:00 - 16:00")

# Determine local timezone (IANA name if available)
local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
tz_id = getattr(local_tz, "key", None)

uid = f"team-meeting-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}@example.com"
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
]

if tz_id:
    lines.append(f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_id}:{start_dt.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}")
    lines.append(f"DTEND;TZID={tz_id}:{end_dt.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}")
else:
    utc_start = start_dt.replace(tzinfo=local_tz).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    utc_end = end_dt.replace(tzinfo=local_tz).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    lines.append(f"DTSTART:{utc_start.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}")
    lines.append(f"DTEND:{utc_end.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}")

lines += [
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting scheduled for next Wednesday at 3 PM. Duration: 1 hour.",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Reminder: Team Meeting",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"
with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(content)
print("ICS file written: team_meeting.ics")
